title: Skip the gate round, or say so in the brief, when the slice is already done and the round's implementer made no change

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback in ork run ork-20261118-225521-b892 (item S418). In round 3 the gate's brief showed the slice as done and the tree as clean. The implementer's report said "No changes; worktree clean". The gate had no plain statement that nothing happened since its last report. S635, merged into this slice, found the same gap on an owner-answer resume. A reviewer's brief said the tree was unchanged since round 1 while it carried an owner answer that needs code changes, and nothing said that no fix round had run yet.

The owner decided (adj 645, `gate.unchanged-round`, "Brief line", session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27). The gate still runs. Its resumed brief gains a plain line that says the slice is done, the tree is unchanged and no fix round ran. The line extends the `## Resumed session` text at `internal/engine/brief.go:257` and covers the owner-answer case. No gate round is skipped.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-27: adj 645 (brief line, the gate still runs) and adj 652 (two lines, whichever is true).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestResumedBriefDoneUnchangedLine (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): a resumed brief with `TreeUnchangedSince` 2, `SliceDone` true and `FixRoundSince` false has a `## Resumed session` section. The section contains "The slice is marked done." and "No fix round has run since then." It also still contains "The tree is unchanged since round 2, when you last reported."
- TestResumedBriefDoneUnchangedAfterFixRoundLine (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): the same input with `FixRoundSince` true says "A fix round ran after that report and left the tree unchanged." It does not say "No fix round has run since then."
- TestResumedBriefUnchangedNotDoneOmitsDoneLine (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): with `SliceDone` false the section says the tree is unchanged and no fix round ran, and does not say "The slice is marked done."
- TestResumedBriefChangedTreeOmitsNoChangeLines (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): with `TreeUnchangedSince` 0 and `SliceDone` true the section has neither "marked done" nor either fix-round sentence. It keeps the git status and git diff re-run instruction.
- TestResumedReviewerBriefSaysNoFixRoundRanAfterOwnerAnswer (`internal/engine/engine_test.go`): a read-only round runs, then the same role resumes with no implementer round between. The second brief contains "The tree is unchanged since round 2" and "No fix round has run since then."
- TestResumedGateBriefSaysFixRoundLeftTreeUnchanged (`internal/engine/engine_test.go`): this uses `resumedTreeBrief` with role gate and no edit. The implementer round 3 runs between the gate's round 2 and its resume, and changes nothing. The brief contains "A fix round ran after that report and left the tree unchanged."
- TestResumedGateBriefOmitsFixRoundLineAfterAnEdit (`internal/engine/engine_test.go`): with `edit` true the brief contains neither fix-round sentence.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, add two fields to `BriefInput` next to `TreeUnchangedSince`. `SliceDone bool` means the slice's tracking status is done. `FixRoundSince bool` means an implementer round ran after the role's last report.
2. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, extend the `in.TreeUnchangedSince > 0` branch of `## Resumed session` (line 256). After the existing sentence "The tree is unchanged since round %d, when you last reported.", append the status and fix-round sentences:
   - If `SliceDone` is true, add "The slice is marked done."
   - If `FixRoundSince` is true, add "A fix round ran after that report and left the tree unchanged."
   - Otherwise add "No fix round has run since then."
   - Keep the closing instruction to re-read every cited file.
   - Leave the `TreeUnchangedSince == 0` text and the `doneWhen` items unchanged.
3. In `internal/engine/round.go`, in the resumed branch at lines 736-747, once `in.TreeUnchangedSince = old.Round` is set, set `in.FixRoundSince` to true when any `rec.Roles` entry has `Role == RoleImplementer` and `Round > old.Round`.
4. In `internal/engine/round.go`, set `in.SliceDone` from `sliceJSON`. Unmarshal the top-level `status` field of the `slicer show --json --lean` output that line 606 already reads, and compare it to "done". Do not make a new slicer call. A parse failure leaves it false.
5. Write the tests listed under Failing tests, red first. Add the four brief-level tests in `internal/engine/brief_test.go` beside `TestResumedBriefUnchangedLine`. Add the three engine-level tests in `internal/engine/engine_test.go` beside `TestResumedGateBriefSaysTreeUnchanged`, reusing or generalizing `resumedTreeBrief`.
6. Update `docs/design.md` (the S424 paragraph at lines 2006-2010) and `docs/state.md` (lines 597-600). They should say the unchanged-tree section also states whether the slice is marked done and whether a fix round ran since the role's last report (adj 645). Mark the addition *proposed* until the record is applied.
7. Run `slicer changelog add S455 --text "..."` with one bullet: a resumed read-only brief says when the slice is done and no fix round has changed the tree. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Acceptance: a resumed read-only brief whose tree is unchanged says whether the slice is marked done and whether a fix round ran since the role's last report. A resumed brief whose tree changed, or has no fingerprint, keeps the old text.
- `go test -run TestResumedBriefDoneUnchangedLine ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestResumedBriefDoneUnchangedAfterFixRoundLine ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestResumedBriefUnchangedNotDoneOmitsDoneLine ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestResumedBriefChangedTreeOmitsNoChangeLines ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestResumedReviewerBriefSaysNoFixRoundRanAfterOwnerAnswer ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestResumedGateBriefSaysFixRoundLeftTreeUnchanged ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestResumedGateBriefOmitsFixRoundLineAfterAnEdit ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestResumedBriefUnchangedLine ./internal/engine` still exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
